newsitem.title: USA: UPS, Teamsters to resume contract talks.
newsitem.headline: UPS, Teamsters to resume contract talks.

text.p: The International Brotherhood of Teamsters and United Parcel Service, the biggest U.S. shipper, will resume contract talks on Sunday evening in an effort to avert a threatened strike, a federal mediator said.
"We will resume those discussions at 6 p.m. EDT (2200 GMT)" in Washington, said John Calhoun Wells, director of the Federal Mediation and Conciliation Service.
Wells said the two sides remained apart on a number of points.
He cited the Teamsters president, Ron Carey, as having said that the union would not again extend its midnight Thursday.
"He (Carey) has told me unequivocally this is a drop-dead deadline," Wells told reporters outside the headquarters of the mediation service.
"We are going into this negotiating session with a real sense of urgency," he said.
